title: Prose and code mix in one batch when that lands both sooner; prose never merges ahead of the code it describes
ruling: Owner 11:19 and 11:24 CST Nov 13, in runner 10 chat, relayed by the retrospective 11:25 CST: prose and code stay in separate batches "when it's faster". His 20:24 CST Nov 11 words (page item 521) were about merge order, not a wall. Reading (restart-plan 168159d3, 3.13): the batch runner mixes prose and code in one batch when that lands both sooner; a prose lane that describes code not yet on main never merges ahead of that code; the same batch is fine. Replaces the readings "as their own batches" (retrospective) and "never share a batch" (coordinator 11:34 CST Nov 12).
